The [[Seeker of Whispers]] explains in detail about the [[Lightbringer]]s and awards the bonus skills that comes from having sufficient [[Lightbringer rank]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Chantry of Secrets}}

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*[[Rally The Princes]]

==Dialogue==
Did not obtain any Lightbringer points:
:''"What are you doing here? This is a place for those willing to die for the cause. How is it possible that you reached this place without once doing anything that would mark you as a Lightbringer?"''

Obtained at least 1 Lightbringer point:
:''"By now you have heard people refer to you as a [[Lightbringer]]. The responsibility that goes along with that [[title]] is great.
:'''⇒ What is a Lightbringer?'''
:'''⇒ Tell me about [[Lightbringer rank]]s.'''
::''"We are all Lightbringers...if we choose to be. A Lightbringer is someone who serves as a beacon to others, illuminating the way of righteousness in these dark times. Demons walk these lands. It is the duty of the willing to drive them back to the cold crypts from whence they came."''
::'''⇒ I'd like to hear about something else.'''
:::Goes back to the beginning.
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''
:'''⇒ Tell me about Lightbringer ranks.'''
::''"Each rank you gain as a Lightbringer will make you more powerful. Once you gain a high enough rank, you will be taught skills known only to the [[Order of Whispers]]."''
::'''⇒ I'd like to hear about something else.'''
:::Goes back to the beginning.
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''
:'''⇒ Tell me about Lightbringer points.'''
::''"As you battle the forces of darkness, you will earn Lightbringer points. If you wish to rise quickly as a Lightbringer, heed the advice of Whispers informants you encounter. Through their teachings you will hone your craft."''
::'''⇒ I'd like to hear about something else.'''
:::Goes back to the beginning.
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''
:'''⇒ Tell me about the [[Whispers Informant]]s.'''
::''"What is there to know? If they allow you to see them, it is likely they have something worthwhile to tell you."''
::'''⇒ I'd like to hear about something else.'''
:::Goes back to the beginning.
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''
:'''× I'll be on my way.'''

Alternative for when talked to for the first time after reaching rank 1 or higher on the [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer title track]]:
:''You're now a [Lightbringer title]. When you display this title, Abaddon's servants will fear you. To display a title, open your hero panel and click on the check box next to the Lightbringer title.''
::[[Image:Lightbringer.jpg]] '''I will use this skill to defeat Abaddon's servants.'''
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''

Alternative for when talked to for the first time after reaching rank 2 or higher on the [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer title track]]:
:''You're now a [Lightbringer title]. You can be trusted with a secret of the Order of Whispers: Lightbringer's Gaze. This skill will help you fight Abaddon's servants.''
::[[Image:Lightbringer's Gaze.jpg]] '''I will use this skill to defeat Abaddon's servants.'''
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''

Alternative for when talked to for the first time after reaching rank 3 or higher on the [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer title track]]:
:''You're now a [Lightbringer title]. You can be trusted with a secret of the Order of Whispers: Lightbringer's Focus.{{sic}} This skill will help you when fighting Abaddon's servants.''
::[[Image:Lightbringer Signet.jpg]] '''I will use this skill to defeat Abaddon's servants.'''
::'''× I'll be on my way.'''

==Notes==
*In order to prompt you to visit the Seeker of Whispers when you are eligible for [[Lightbringer]], the normal dialogue for providers of [[Blessing]]s that advance the title track is replaced with this:
:''Greetings, Lightbringer. I have a message for you from the Seeker of Whispers. He believes you are capable of standing up to Varesh and Abaddon's demonic hordes. Seek him out in the Chantry of Secrets. He will help prepare you for the battles to come.''
:*This prevents you from gaining further points using blessings until you go and visit the Seeker of Whispers, as the providers of blessing will not hand out the blessings until you do so.
